_comment: Copy to appsettings.Production.json ON THE PI (it is gitignored and must never be committed), fill in the real values, chmod 600.

Scraper._HotBurnWindowSafetyFraction: Revisit a card selling >= HotRateThreshold/day after this much of its burn window. Absorbs an acceleration of up to 1/fraction between visits: 0.3 covers 3.3x. Turn it DOWN if a card loses sales to a burst again — 0.25 covers 4x, 0.2 covers 5x. Total crawl demand incl. the 30-day floor, on repriced rates: 0.4 -> ~4437/day, 0.3 -> ~4952, 0.2 -> ~6100, against a ~8400/day ceiling. Restart the service to apply.
Scraper._Ceilings: The absolute backstop the fraction cannot give: the fraction multiplies the rate estimate, so a wrong estimate defeats it (the Aug 2026 losses). A card selling >= FastCeilingRate/day never waits more than FastCeilingDays; >= HotRateThreshold never more than HotCeilingDays — loss impossible below 30/ceiling (20/day and 10/day) however stale the estimate. FastCeilingDays went 2.0 -> 1.5 on 2026-08-17 (Mewtwo & Mew GX: a ceiling-bound card the dial cannot reach lost the race by 16 seconds). Costs ~+2200 visits/day combined on 2026-08-17 rates. Cold cards get no ceiling on purpose.
Scraper._NearMissMargin: Rows of overlap at or below which a visit logs a near miss and counts on crawl.bucket_near_miss. Zero overlap is not a near miss but an actual loss, alerted separately.
Scraper._Tcgdex: ADR-0009/0012. One mirror directory per locale, and the directory IS the version pin: the lanes fetch TCGdex's per-set JSON there once (~219 en + ~177 ja requests, 1s apart) and join offline; every sweep after that only re-reads the one-page set list and downloads sets the directory lacks (the top-up), so new releases arrive within a day while pinned documents never change. Delete a directory to fully re-pin. The alias files are hand-curated set mappings deployed beside the blacklist — the ja file is the ONLY way a Japanese set maps. The series-eras file (ADR-0011) maps TCGdex serie display names (English and Japanese, ordinal-exact) to era codes for set_details.era; unset, paths default relative to the service WorkingDirectory, which is where the deploy recipe puts the curated files.
